{{Quote|Somehow I don't think a bunch of cute, furry, three-foot-tall mustalids armed with laser popguns is gonna give the Imperial governor any sleepless nights.|A crewmember of the ''Dorion Discus''|<ref name="RoBW" />}}
The '''Sessehshellah''', or '''Sesseh'''', were a fierce aboriginal race of [[mustalid]]s native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]]. Though skilled at swimming, combat, and stealth, the Sessehshellah had little in the way of advanced technology; resultantly, they were easy prey for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which [[Mining|exploited]] Shaymore's [[hydrocarbon]]s. The Sessehshellah were subsequently aided by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], who supplied them with modern [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]; both parties worked together in a successful bid to derail the hydrocarbon extraction effort and force the Imperials off Shaymore.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|My people will never submit to the rule of the Emperor's craven bureaucrats.''"<br />"''Yeah? Well, when the Imperials are done with your lovely little planet, it's gonna smell like something outta the ''Dorion Discus''{{'s}} autokitchen.''"<br />"''But armed with the Alliance weapons in your hold, my people will be a force to be reckoned with.|A Sessehshellah and a crewmember of the ''Dorion Discus''|<ref name="RoBW" />}}
The Sessehshellah, also dubbed the Sesseh', were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] aboriginal [[Species/Legends|race]] of [[mustalid]]s native to the<ref name="RoBW" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;Based on corresponding data for [[Shaymore system/Legends|Shaymore system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]]. Resembling [[river otter]]s and standing at a height of three [[Foot/Legends|feet]], the Sesehshellah were coated in [[Hair/Legends|fur]], had small [[Limb/Legends|paws]], and could be considered cute. The Sessehshellah temperament was comparable to that of the [[Weasel/Legends|weasel]], and members of the species also had natural skills in swimming, stealth, and ferocious martial vigor; with respect to the latter, Sessehshellah could use their [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] to fight if necessary.<ref name="RoBW" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Perhaps your timid ancestors were more accustomed to slavery?''"<br />"''No, indeed, but my timid ancestors weren't dumb enough to attack stormtroopers with sharpened clam shells fastened to sticks&hellip;|A Sessehshellah and a crewmember of the ''Dorion Discus''|<ref name="RoBW" />}}
The Sessehshellah were a technologically rudimentary race and had little in the way of [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]], toting sharpened [[Clam/Legends|clam]] shells fastened to sticks; however, they were able to use more advanced armaments such as [[Explosive charge/Legends|demolition charges]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] if supplied with such. The Sessehshellah also held a great respect for their environment. Caution and practical thinking were seen as lacking in spirit by the Sessehshellah, although they were capable of appreciating shrewdness and clever tactics. The Sessehshellah spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]].<ref name="RoBW" />

==History==
[[File:Alliance Starbird.svg|thumb|right|200px|The Rebel Alliance (emblem pictured) assisted the Sessehshellah in their efforts to expel the Galactic Empire from Shaymore.]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Shaymore was invaded by the Imperials and a number of [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]] were established to [[Mining|extract]] the planet's fossil [[hydrocarbon]]s. With their basic weapons no match for the Empire's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], the Sessehshellah sent delegates to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to appeal for military aid. Although the Alliance's measured approach to unseating the Imperials initially clashed with their more tempestuous instincts, the Sessehshellah eventually agreed to cooperate, and in turn educate the Alliance on protecting Shaymore's ecosystem. The delegates returned to Shaymore aboard the<ref name="RoBW" /> [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]<ref name="RegCay">{{WEGCite|story=Regina Cayli (adventure)|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref> ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' alongside a Rebel taskforce and a hold-full of modern weaponry.<ref name="RoBW" />

Subsequently, the Sessehshellah launched an attack on an Imperial patrol, prompting a retaliatory offensive that resulted in the destruction of a [[Unidentified Sessehshellah village|Sessehshellah village]]. The incident further drove home the importance of the Alliance's tactics for the Sessehshellah, and the mustalids guided an Alliance strike team to an [[Imperial power station]] in the depths of Shaymore's [[Swamp|marshes]], protecting them from several [[amphibious wolf|amphibious wolves]] along the way. The [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] infiltration was successful with the assistance of the Sessehshellah, and the Rebels managed to [[Sabotage of an Imperial power station|sabotage]] the installation; in so doing, they obtained a [[Comm unit scrambler|communications scrambler]] enabling them to intercept Imperial transmissions. Using the device, the Alliance operatives determined that Shaymore would be abandoned by the Empire if hydrocarbon production were not increased ten-fold, and that the supply was dwindling. The Sessehshellah mounted an attack at the [[Imperial hydrocarbon refinery|main refinery]] to draw away the guards and clear a path for the Rebels to [[Sabotage of an Imperial hydrocarbon refinery|incapacitate]] the facility's storage tanks.<ref name="RoBW" />

{{RPGseed}}
The Sessehshellah joined the Rebels in using [[raft]]s to traverse a river running along the storage facility's outer fence. While an Alliance contingent disguised as guards bluffed their way past local security, the Sessehshellah dived into the facility's drainage ditches and planted demolition charges at the drainage valves for the storage tanks. Meanwhile, Sessehshellah reinforcements stormed the refinery compound and relieved the Imperial contingent of several blasters to aid the Rebels; with the way cleared, the Alliance operatives hijacked a [[Cruiser (aquatic)|cruiser]] from the nearby [[Boat/Legends|boat]] dock and made their escape as the demolition charges detonated and crippled the storage facility. Despite Imperial efforts to chase down the saboteurs, the Sessehshellah and their cohorts were able to stage ambushes in the local marshes, scattering the Imperial forces.<ref name="RoBW" />
{{EndGame}}

The storage facility was destroyed, and the Empire's forces defeated; with the hydrocarbon harvesting operation defunct and the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] recalled, the Sessehshellah retook Shaymore.<ref name="RoBW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sessehshellah appeared in "[[Rings of Bright Water]]", an adventure written by [[Ken Rolston]] and collected in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[October]] [[1987]].<ref name="RoBW" />
